Proteomics of muscle chronological ageing in post-menopausal women
Muscle samples were compared between adult (56 years) and old (78 years) post-menopausal women.

Twenty four post-menopausal women undergoing elective hip surgery for hip arthrosis were selected in the present study and divided in two groups: adult women aged 56.4 ± 1.3 years (n = 11; age range 48–61 years) and old women aged 78.3 ± 0.5 years (n = 13; age range 76–82 years).
Muscle samples were compared between adult (56 years) and old (78 years) post-menopausal women.
